latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Complete guide for setting up Claude Code in Docker with persistent, web-accessible terminal and multi-agent workflows.

- Provides step-by-step setup for Claude Code in Docker containers, including quick start instructions.
- Integrates ttyd (web terminal) and tmux (session persistence) for browser-based shell access.
- Offers optional acpx installation for multi-agent development workflows.
- Details environment variable setup for configuring API keys and providers.
- Includes instructions for Docker directory persistence and clear architecture overview.
- Documentation is fully bilingual (English and Chinese).
